name: Ascertainment-corrected SNP heritability on the liability scale
model_likelihood: Observed binary status y=mu+u+e; covariance A sigma_u^2+I sigma_e^2
prior: Random additive genetic effects; Gaussian liability components from the liability threshold model
inference_algorithm: REML variance components followed by scale and ascertainment transformation
estimand: Population liability-scale variance tagged by SNPs; transform observed-scale heritability for reporting
data_input: Individual genotypes and binary disease status; allele frequencies and derived relationship matrix; population prevalence K and sample case fraction P

name: Liability threshold model
model_likelihood: Standard-normal population liability l=mu+g+e; case status above a threshold
prior: Normal additive genetic and environmental components
estimand: Liability-scale heritability and observed-to-liability scale relationship
data_input: Population prevalence K and case fraction P for the observed-to-liability scale relationship
